title: Background Weather Alerts & Notification Accuracy Fix
releaseNotes: Background Weather Alerts: Fixed background weather monitoring so heat and thunderstorm advisories trigger reliably even when the app is closed.
Commute Dismissal Timing: Corrected dismissal alert calculations to wait for multi-hour lectures and lab sessions to finish.
Task Deadline Reminders: Fixed 1-hour task alarms to calculate based on the actual deadline time rather than default morning hours.
Settings Preference Sync: Synchronized weather alert toggles across app settings and native background services.
